decision: PASS with measured-compression scenarios, intermediate replication 1 and continuous monitoring; not an unconditional compression bound
assumptions: Do not extrapolate small compressed file size to pair volume; stage03 measured C used.
Stage04/05 use DefaultCodec and replication 1; source/preparation/final use replication 3. Loss of single-replica intermediate requires recomputation.
64 reducers bound an individual partition; block 512 from existing stage03 is unchanged.
Shuffle/merge peak factor 2.0 over all materialized shuffle; 20% node skew/reserve multiplier. One additional largest reducer retry budget per node, no speculative tasks.
H800 HDFS and YARN shuffle use separate filesystems; no deletion of old evidence or other users data.
16/12/16 bytes are planning scenarios, not mathematical upper bounds. If runtime exceeds these, reevaluate remaining partitions/disk before next stage.

medium_reference.warning: Actual medium task throughput used only as a range guide; wider IDs and larger cluster allocation prevent a direct runtime promise.

monitoring: 45s SSH filesystem and process snapshots + YARN REST, persisted JSONL; reevaluate at each stage transition.
